## B7 Design differences (evidence in brackets)

| aspect | HydroML/UMFI (R) | guanton/umfi_python (Python) | sharedimp (R) | sharedimp (Python) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| rows used to estimate the residualization | all rows of X [R/umfi.R:14] | all rows of X [umfi/UMFI.py:60] | training rows of each split; coefficients applied to the assessment rows [check B5a/r] | training rows of each split; coefficients applied to the assessment rows [check B5a/python] |
| when a feature is residualized on the anchor | only if the slope has p < 0.01 [R/preprocess_lr.R:17] | only if R^2 > 0.01 [umfi/preprocess_LR.py:42] | always [check B1/gate_not_fired/sharedimp_r] | always [check B1/gate_not_fired/sharedimp_py] |
| random noise added to (near-)constant columns | yes [R/preprocess_lr.R:15; R/preprocess_lr.R:18] | yes [umfi/preprocess_LR.py:33; umfi/preprocess_LR.py:47] | no (deterministic; see residualize_fit) [signature of residualize_fit()] | no (deterministic; see AnchorResidualizer) [signature of AnchorResidualizer()] |
| learner | ranger random forest, 100 trees, fixed [R/umfi.R:17] | extra trees (default) or random forest (RF=True), n_trees = 100 by default [umfi/UMFI.py:102; umfi/UMFI.py:99] | argument `learner`: built-in forest or linear model, any parsnip model specification, or a fit/predict pair [signature of shared_importance()] | argument `estimator`: any scikit-learn estimator [signature of shared_importance()] |
| data on which the two models are scored | out-of-bag predictions of the forest fitted on all rows [R/umfi.R:19] | out-of-bag predictions of the forest fitted on all rows [umfi/UMFI.py:114] | assessment rows of each split (arguments `v`, `repeats`, `resamples`) [signature of shared_importance()] | test rows of each split (argument `cv`, `groups`) [signature of shared_importance()] |
| metric | R^2 for a numeric response, accuracy for a factor; fixed [R/umfi.R:20] | the forest's `oob_score_` (R^2 or accuracy); fixed [umfi/UMFI.py:114] | argument `metric`: common metric name or yardstick metric [signature of shared_importance()] | argument `scoring`: common metric name, scikit-learn scorer or callable [signature of shared_importance()] |
| negative scores and negative importances | scores floored (0 for R^2, 0.5 for accuracy); negative importances set to 0 [R/umfi.R:22] | scores floored at 0; negative importances set to 0 [umfi/UMFI.py:120] | kept as they are [check B6/sharedimp_r] | kept as they are [check B6/sharedimp_py] |
| repetition and reported spread | one run; a numeric vector [R/umfi.R:11] | `niter` runs (default 10); mean over runs and a table of every run [umfi/UMFI.py:47] | mean over splits, between-split SD, per-split table (`fold_results()`) [signature of shared_importance()] | mean over splits, between-split SD, per-split table (`fold_results`) [signature of shared_importance()] |
| seed argument | none (global R random number generator) [signature of umfi()] | none (global NumPy random number generator) [signature of UMFI()] | `seed` [signature of shared_importance()] | `random_state` [signature of shared_importance()] |
| dependence-removal methods other than linear regression | optimal transport (`mod_meth = "ot"`, `"ot_atomic"`) [R/umfi.R:13] | optimal transport; automatic choice between the two per feature [umfi/UMFI.py:58] | not implemented (linear regression only) [signature of shared_importance()] | not implemented (linear regression only) [signature of shared_importance()] |
| parallel execution | `umfi_par()` (foreach) [signature of umfi_par()] | none [signature of UMFI()] | none [signature of shared_importance()] | `n_jobs` (joblib) [signature of shared_importance()] |
